reports.title: Moog Inc. Delivers Record Fiscal 2026 Results;

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Financial Guidance
section: "We had a strong finish to a record year. Our fourth quarter was marked by record sales in each of our segments, a robust operating margin and strong cash generation," said Jennifer Walter, CFO. "In fiscal year 2027, we'll continue to build upon our financial strength with record sales, stronger operating performance and meaningful operating cash flows."

(in millions, except per share results) | FY 2027 Guidance | FY 2026
Net sales | 4,950 | 4,523
Adjusted segment operating margin | 14.2 | 14.2
Adjusted segment operating margin, excluding the FY 2026 tariff refund | 14.2 | 13.5
Adjusted diluted net earnings per share(1) | 13.30 | 12.36
Free cash flow(2) | 250 | 307
